title: atomic_json crash-rollback test does not pin dir-fsync durability ordering
description: Wave-1 review (security/robustness, P3): python/tests/test_vector_atomic_json.py:403-472 pins event ordering (rollback -> rolled_back journal -> cleanup) but cannot catch deletion of _fsync_directory(parent_fd) at test/vectors/atomic_json.py:532. Without that fsync a power-loss window leaves journal=prepared with backups already unlinked; _read_recovery_artifact_at then raises FileNotFoundError (atomic_json.py:389-390, uncaught) and permanently poisons every future write to the directory. Fix: monkeypatch _fsync_directory to record call order and assert a dir-fsync lands between the rolled_back journal write and the backup unlinks. Discovered-from wave 1 bead project-LICHEN-worker6-d7tb.
close_reason: Fixed in wave 1 follow-up: casefold guard + aliased regression, parametrize entry, fsync-ordering pin, hold-down constants, wait_for timeouts + ctime_ns. Suites green (44+178+130).
